# `oaap tenant`

accounts and tenants of this node (oaap.core.tenant).

**Root:** depends on the action -- see the table below.

## Usage

```sh
oaap tenant {list,show,check,log,create,rename,face,idp,policy,adopt,remove,build,egress,allow,disallow} [name] [target] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `--archive ARCHIVE` | for 'adopt': the tenant archive to take on. Only onto a node that is EMPTY for this tenant -- every collision is named and nothing is merged (RFC-0041 K6) |
| `name` | tenant label (default: 'default') |
| `target` | the new label, for 'rename' |
| `--name TITLE` | the customer's name in plain words, e.g. 'Kunde Meier GmbH' |
| `--account ACCOUNT` | account reference (UUID) this tenant belongs to |
| `--account-name ACCOUNT_NAME` | cached display name of that account |
| `--grace-days GRACE_DAYS` | how long the old label keeps answering after a rename (default 30) |
| `--yes` | carry out a rename after reading its consequences |
| `-n COUNT` | how many audit entries to show (default 50) |
| `--title FACE_TITLE` | public title of this tenant's place; '' clears it |
| `--color-primary COLOR_PRIMARY` | the colour that carries the brand, as #rrggbb |
| `--color-accent COLOR_ACCENT` | the second colour, for states and emphasis |
| `--logo LOGO` | path to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (max 512 KB) |
| `--clear-logo` | remove this tenant's logo |
| `--issuer ISSUER` | the provider's issuer URL, e.g. https://auth.example.org/realms/hbvp |
| `--client-id CLIENT_ID` | the OIDC client this node presents itself as |
| `--client-secret CLIENT_SECRET` | that client's secret; kept 0600 on this node only |
| `--idp-kind IDP_KIND` | provider kind (default oidc) (one of `oidc`) |
| `--idp-label IDP_LABEL` | what the button on the login page says |
| `--idp-version IDP_VERSION` | the provider version this was built against (Keycloak 26.7.4 is pinned) |
| `--dry-run` | for 'adopt': say what would happen, write nothing |
| `--param KEY=VALUE` | for 'build start': a parameter of the profile -- repeatable |
| `--purge-instances` | for 'build rollback': delete the data of the instances this build installed, too |
| `--step STEP` | for 'build confirm': the waiting step |
| `--json` | for 'build': the state as JSON |
| `--close` | for 'egress': close this tenant; its instances start no connection of their own |
| `--open` | for 'egress': open it again, with --reason |
| `--except-instance EXCEPT_INSTANCE` | for 'egress': except one instance, with --reason |
| `--end-exception END_EXCEPTION` | for 'egress': end one instance's exception |
| `--allow-destination ALLOW_DESTINATION` | for 'egress': allow one http destination for this tenant's closed instances, with --reason |
| `--disallow-destination DISALLOW_DESTINATION` | for 'egress': take that back; refused while bound |
| `--clear-idp` | detach the provider; the users' bindings stay |
| `--first-login FIRST_LOGIN` | eingang (default) \| role \| groups (one of `eingang`, `role`, `groups`) |
| `--default-role DEFAULT_ROLE` | the role a first login receives, for role/groups |
| `--self-registration SELF_REGISTRATION` | whether the realm lets people register themselves -- written down here, MOVED by `oaap idp settings` (one of `on`, `off`) |
| `--second-factor SECOND_FACTOR` | whether the realm asks for a second factor; OAAP never checks one itself (RFC-0041 K7) (one of `off`, `required`) |
| `--group-map GROUP_MAP` | realm-group=oaap-group,... -- an explicit local mapping; an unmapped group grants nothing |
| `--reason IDP_REASON` | why a dangerous combination is wanted, or for 'egress' why this is opened or excepted; goes into this tenant's log |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | no |
| `show` | no |
| `check` | no |
| `log` | no |
| `create` | yes |
| `rename` | yes |
| `face` | yes |
| `idp` | yes |
| `policy` | yes |
| `adopt` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `build` | yes |
| `egress` | yes |
| `allow` | yes |
| `disallow` | yes |
